stem:
Scott has 28 toy cars to put on 4 shelves. He wants to put the same number of cars on each shelf.

How many toy cars should Scott put on each shelf?

text: How many toy cars should Scott put on each shelf?
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires only a straightforward division (28 ÷ 4) to find the answer, involving direct recall of division concepts.
